name: unsw
_comment: Development dataset: interleaved source blocks and the same shortcut policy as the other datasets. Source = session 1 attack period (first 190,000 flows); embargo = rest of session 1 + 26-day gap; deployment = session 2, 24 windows.

shortcut_policy._comment: Same policy as the other datasets: exclude each listed host/OS fingerprint feature whose single-feature AUC on the source train block is >= 0.99; other flagged features stay and are reported; an all-features variant is reported as sensitivity.
